scope: Literal cross-CID response ownership, bounded WINK payload, pre-parser framing failure and disabled-WebAuthn dispatch. Actual production C/Rust with per-event drained HID IN; no physical or withheld-IN/IRQ acceptance.

cases.preconditions: Fresh storage; configured USB. Poll CCID, HID and WebUSB in device_loop order for each event. Drain HID IN to idle within that event, completing each report and resuming Rust TX; C TX waits synchronously for completion. Fixed nonzero CID; no INIT allocation or response normalization.

difference.reason: Pinned C exposes and advances another HID CID's retained source. Rust must return busy and preserve the original owner; identical output would violate response isolation.
